decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Design and Access Statement, Noise Impact Assessment (5779.NIA.01), 099-P2, 199-P2, 200-P2, 400-P2, 410-P2, 401-P2, 411-P2, Received 23 November 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the premises at 395 Chiswick High Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until detailed drawings of replacement cornice mouldings have been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cornice mouldings shall be replaced on each side of the fascia prior to the occupation of the premises. 

Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - The scheme of extract ventilation shown on the approved drawings and detailed within the Noise Impact Assessment (5779.NIA.01) shall be carried out before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 6 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the control of fumes and odours has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. 

The scheme shall be fully implemented before the premises open to customers.
Condition : 7 - No customers shall remain on the premises outside the hours of 07.00 to 24.00 hours Monday to Sunday, including Bank and Public Holidays.
description: Change of use of the ground and basement levels from A3 (restaurant and cafe) to A3 and A5 (hot food takeaway) use, installation of a shopfront and erection of extraction plant and installation of a louvre to the rear of the premises.
